items.q: Is the journey map based on real customer data?
items.a: It is a structured starting point built from common patterns. Strengthen it with your own interviews, reviews and analytics before making big decisions.

items.q: How many stages does the map have?
items.a: Five stages, from first hearing about you to buying and recommending, each with thoughts, feelings, touchpoints, pain points, actions and KPIs.

items.q: Is the customer journey mapper free?
items.a: Yes. The customer journey mapper is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.
No. It runs inside your browser, so what you type stays on your device and is not sent to us.

items.q: Can you turn the map into a marketing plan?
items.a: Yes. Our team can use it to plan SEO, social, ads and website changes. Start with our Digital Marketing Services.
